text: Aussies. I asked ChatGPT and Scout the exact same question. Honestly? ChatGPT did a good job. But only one showed me where it was cheaper. ChatGPT gave me Aussie stores, Aussie prices, and five picks. One store each, then a quiz about her style. Scout searched Aussie stores too, then checked the same gift at other stores. Ten bucks cheaper here. Six bucks cheaper there. Rated picks, live prices, one list. Scout launches November sixteen. Waitlist's in the bio.
